experiment: v16 early stem fusion + breath-event decoder, reference QC, fixed ground truth and smart fusion
model_label: v16 early fusion + identity channel + raw PPG input + kernel-optimized (64 Hz) + breath-event decoder
model_path: stem branches (k=32/64/128, 8 filters) -> [stem, z-scored identity] -> 1x1 fusion + GroupNorm (no GELU) -> depthwise residual encoder -> dilated decoder trunk -> {waveform head (tanh), breath-event head (logits)}

changes_261005.speed_augmentation: p=0.5, target rate uniform over local rate x (0.7, 1.6) within the dataset band and (6.0, 45.0) bpm
changes_261005.rate_balanced_sampling: weights 1/bin frequency, bins (8.0, 12.0, 16.0, 20.0, 25.0, 30.0, 40.0) bpm, capped at 5.0x median
changes_261005.validation: temporal: 20% of training subjects (>= 3) evenly spaced over the rate ranking; refit on all training subjects for the selected epochs
changes_261005.event_target: sigma = 0.12 x local period, limited to (0.15, 0.5) s
changes_261005.evaluation: FFT RR of the predicted waveform without the sub-harmonic check

decoder_change.trunk: v16 decoder convs (24->16 k7, 16->8 k5) with dilations (8, 16)
decoder_change.event_target: Gaussian bumps (sigma 0.3 s) at reference breaths

loss.total: wave * v16 hybrid + event * BCE(heatmap) + count * soft-count |error| (bpm)

reference_quality.breath_detector: count-orig (RRest ref_cto): peaks > 0.2 x Q3, trough < 0 between breaths
reference_quality.agreement_rule: count-orig RR vs FFT RR < 2.0 bpm
reference_quality.evaluation_use: each 60 s minute must pass the rule to be scored

ground_truth: expert breath labels where the dataset provides them (CapnoBase co2 start of expiration); otherwise breath onsets detected once on the continuous reference RSP (60 s blocks, 10 s context)

CapnoBase.description: 0.05 Hz to clip(0.5 x PPG heart rate, 0.5, 1.0) Hz, capnogram delay alignment with fixed polarity, 40-220 bpm PPG beats

capnobase_files.labels: co2_startexp_x (fallback co2_startinsp_x), one cell of space-separated sample numbers, index base 1 removed, unit from units_x
capnobase_files.artifacts: pleth *_artif_x -> unusable PPG samples; co2 *_artif_x -> no training window and no scored minute overlapping them

capnography_adaptive_upper_edge: clip(0.5 x PPG spectral HR, 0.5, 1.0) Hz

min_valid_minutes_per_subject.use: extra subject means over subjects with at least this many reference-valid minutes; the others are listed with their own MAE

smart_fusion.reported: MAE on retained minutes and retained share of valid minutes

model_config.model_input: raw PPG time series, per-window min-max [0, 1], no filter

cross_validation.subject_reuse: each valid subject is held out exactly once

validation: last 20 percent of each training subject's windows

evaluation.timeline_reconstruction: overlap-add mean using original window starts
evaluation.legacy_pcc: waveform Pearson correlation on the same complete 60 s interval
evaluation.gt_metrics: event / count-orig / FFT RR vs fixed ground truth on reference-valid minutes

baseline_comparison.pairing: same dataset, subject, and window condition
baseline_comparison.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over all baseline comparisons
